company.name: Digified
company.shortDescription: Digified is a fin-tech startup that provides Digital Identity Verification Solutions in Egypt and the Middle East.
company.description:
Digified is an Egyptian fin-tech start up (Reg-Tech) that provides Digital Identity Verification Technologies in Egypt, Africa and the Middle East.

We thrive to be the leading Digital Identity provider across the region. Digified offers digital identity solutions that include but are not limited to; Arabic documents OCR, Documents fraud detection, face matching and anti-spoofing, government data bases authentication and AML

productsAndServices.description: A service that identifies and prevents fraudulent activities during digital customer onboarding and identity verification processes.

productsAndServices.description: A remote customer identity verification and onboarding process that enables businesses to securely onboard users without physical presence.
